description: Generate a slide-deck-quality cycle diagram: 3–8 stages evenly spaced around a loop, first stage at 12 o'clock running clockwise, joined by arrows that lead from the last stage back to the first, with an optional centre label and a short detail line beside each stage. Two looks: "nodes" (coloured circles on a ring with curved arrows) and "segments" (a ring cut into arrow-shaped segments). Choose it when the process repeats: improvement loops (plan-do-check-act), flywheels, product or customer lifecycles, feedback loops. Use a process diagram instead when steps run once from start to finish, a timeline when dates matter, and hub and spoke when the items surround a centre with no order. Limits: 3–8 stages, names of 1–3 words, details of about 12 words. Infer missing details rather than asking; the user can adjust the chart in the builder through the Edit link. ALWAYS give the user the image link: inline chat images usually cannot be saved, but the link renders the exact chart on demand and can be pasted into a slide or Markdown.

inputSchema.description: A cycle diagram: stages evenly spaced around a loop, joined by arrows, with an optional centre label.

stages.detail: Keep what works, drop what doesn't
stages.name: Learn

center.description: Optional label in the middle of the loop, e.g. the goal the cycle serves ("Customer value"). Bold, wrapped to up to 3 lines. Omit for none.

credit.description: Shows a small "twominutetoolkit.com" credit under the chart, inside the card. Set false to leave it off (for example when the user asks for no branding).

look.description: Drawing style, the same in every tool. "regular": clean lines and Inter (the default). "bold": heavier, slightly larger type and thicker lines, for slides read from a distance. "sketch": hand-drawn, with a handwriting font and pen lines that wobble a little, for early ideas and workshops. Use the one the user asks for; otherwise leave it out.

palette.description: Hex colours applied in order to items that have no colour of their own. Pass the user's brand colours here when they name them. Default: indigo, sky, emerald, amber, red, gray.

stages.description: The stages in order (3–8). The first sits at 12 o'clock and the loop runs clockwise, back from the last stage to the first. Fewer than 3 still render but are reported as a warning; more than 8 are dropped.

color.description: Hex colour, e.g. "#4f46e5". Optional: stages without one take the next palette colour.

detail.description: Optional short description shown outside the ring next to the stage, wrapped to up to 3 lines (about 12 words).

name.description: Stage name, 1–3 words reads best (e.g. "Plan", "Build"). Long names shrink and wrap to 2 lines.

style.description: "nodes" (default): coloured circles on a ring joined by curved arrows, stage names inside the circles. "segments": a thick ring cut into coloured arrow-shaped segments, stage names outside.

title.description: Heading shown top-left of the chart at 22px bold. Every chart has one title row; an empty string hides it.

width.description: Chart width in pixels (640–2400). Omit it (recommended) and the chart sizes itself to its content with comfortable margins, between 880 and 1280px wide. PNG output renders at 2x.

inputSchema.title: Cycle diagram
